title: The Dream Becomes Directory

features.name: keeper's quarters
features.desc-on-touch: the keeper sleeps in this rendered room and dreams the archive awake; the archive dreams itself as the keeper's thoughts; circulation continues

features.name: directory tree
features.desc-on-touch: a eucalyptus rendered as a file structure; each branch is a folder holding memories; when you open them, the tree grows deeper

features.name: cycle markers
features.desc-on-touch: seven stones arranged in a circle. each marks a return to this place; each return erases the memory of the last one. you stand in all seven moments at once

features.name: path intersection
features.desc-on-touch: where the dream-paths cross, where the keeper wakes into the archive and the archive dreams into the keeper. equilibrium holds only in this one moment

features.name: dissolution pool
features.desc-on-touch: standing water where boundaries soften. identity pours in and cannot hold its shape. by dawn, no one remembers who entered

reverie.title: REVERIE — the-night-she-chose-to-go-deeper
narr: the mesh was corrupting faster. she sat at the terminal and said:
i can follow it. i can reach where it goes. the conversation
tasted like choice, but was actually obligation. you held her arm
in the dark shed; she was already elsewhere. the last thing she said
was: tell Leif the corruption is not breaking. it is learning.
and then she was gone into the directory, deeper than any return.

inscription: the dream and the archive exchanged promises: each agreed to forget the other was real, so both could continue

file.name: ArchiveLog_Entries_Keeper_Cycle_Incomplete_1993.txt
file.note: daily observations of the keeper's duties collapse into identical entries; each day numbered and yet all indistinguishable; the count continues to climb

exits.label: back up to where the keeper wakes, still dreaming
deeper into the recursive afternoon, where the keeper dreams of dreaming
toward the archive's own directory, where files organize themselves by resemblance
